headline: 🔴 Cisco email gateway root RCE exploited and KEV-listed, 🎯 Talos maps three FMC clusters incl. Sandworm and Qilin, 🧅 GitLab CVE-2026-85706 now confirmed exploited, 🐦 Red Heron hits 13 orgs via Gitea n-day, 🌗 Vite dev-server mass-scan hunts cloud keys, 🔬 DDRop interposer breaks DDR5 confidential computing
summary: Cisco's actively exploited pre-auth root RCE in Secure Email Gateway (CVE-2026-76461, KEV) defines the day alongside Talos's three-cluster accounting of Cisco FMC compromise, while CISA confirmed exploitation of GitLab's CVSS 10 file-read and Red Heron's Gitea campaign showed full infrastructure takeover.

overrides.why: Slate score 5.0 understates it: 13 orgs across 6 countries, Proxmox root, a novel Linux implant and an exposed staging server make it the day's richest intrusion read.
Thin multi-outlet roundup of the same GitLab CVE-2026-85706 already carried by the canonical GitLab story; covering it would duplicate the REVISIT item.
Duplicate cluster of the F5-documented Vite campaign; the richer bleepingcomputer-based analysis carries the same CVE-2026-39364 facts.
Same Red Heron Gitea campaign as the promoted slug; folded into the Acronis TRU analysis which has the staging-server and rootkit detail.
Routine single-victim leak-site claim, one of many today (Shadowbyt3, Emperador, Qilin, Rhysida), with no novel TTPs in the write-up.
All four new events are outlet re-reports of the September 14 SecurityWeek worm-like attack story already covered yesterday.
New events are re-reports of the UNC3569 confirmation and full sgbiz chain carried in yesterday's lead paragraph.
Single new event is a threatnoir aggregator re-report; the ShieldCrash delta was already covered September 14.
Four new events are same-day re-reports of the CVE-2026-31278 disclosure covered yesterday.
The Vietnam-linked IP addition was already reported yesterday; the fresh Pakistani actor gets its own NEW item instead.
Only new material is a securityonline re-report of the September 9-10 PivotC2 research covered September 10.
Only new event is a Dutch-language re-report of Anthropic reporting already covered; the distinct alignment-assessment story is included instead.
Duplicate cluster of the Revolut breach covered yesterday; its 12 events are the same disclosure wave, no new substance.
CATCH-UP aggregator whose newest development is 35 days old; nothing reportable.
REVISIT flag with zero new events in 20 days since the August 27 coverage; no delta to report.
Automated beaconbeagle feed notices with no analysis or campaign context; noise rather than a story.
